title: Seed loader: an org-scoped reference probe filters on organization_id even when the target declares another tenantField
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cw787kMeaX7oyz7DDC

Loose end of #33207 / #33206 (PR #33222, merged 2026-11-14T15:49Z), filed at seat 5's direction from area A4's parked review fixes. Read at `origin/main` 2026-11-14T18:2xZ.

## Line

A seed reference whose target object walls its rows by a **declared** `tenancy.tenantField` other than `organization_id` (e.g. `workspace_id`, injected column switched off) · the seed loader's org-scoped reference probe · rare (custom tenant field) · read, not measured.

`packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts` on main:

- `probeScopeOf` returns `organization` for such a target (it is not `global`, because `resolveTenantFieldName(definition)` is non-null), and
- the probe then filters `where.organization_id = organizationId` (around line 2832), a column the target does not have.

So the probe either errors or matches nothing, and the reference is reported unresolved although a row of that organization exists. The rest of the parked fix is already on main (exhaustive id-ordered member paging; a refused membership probe reported on `sys_member`; `global` only when no tenant column).

## Do

- In the `organization` scope, filter on the target's resolved tenant column (`resolveTenantFieldName(definition)`, falling back to `organization_id`), not on `organization_id` always.
- Pin it: a target declaring `tenancy: { enabled: true, tenantField: 'workspace_id' }` with the injected column off; a seed row referencing it by name resolves to the row of the seeding organization and not to another organization's row of the same name. Ablate.

Reader who acts: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts` (`probeScopeOf` and the reference probe), `packages/runtime/src/seed-org-scoped-references.integration.test.ts`.
Suggested grade: p3. Lane: `domain:server`.
